# Evaluation code of pi^3

Files copied unchanged from the evaluation code of pi^3, commit 97ce97b8e067e7bff5b5c8e507776e4e95189fac: `configs/data/depth.yaml`, `configs/data/relpose-distance.yaml`, `configs/data/mv_recon.yaml`, `utils/__init__.py`, `utils/files.py`, `utils/depth.py`, `utils/geometry.py`, `relpose/evo_utils.py`, `mv_recon/utils.py`, `datasets/sevenscenes.py`, `datasets/nrgbd.py`, `datasets/utils/__init__.py`, `datasets/utils/cropping.py`, `datasets/seq-id-maps/7scenes_mv-recon_seq-id-map-kf40.json`, `datasets/seq-id-maps/NRGBD_mv-recon_seq-id-map-kf100.json`. They are distributed under its license (`LICENSE`, "Pi3 for non-commercial purposes"), whose copyright notice and conditions are kept. The scripts in `eval/` load these files by path and point their data roots to the folder given on the command line; no file here is modified.
